scope.method: Read-only code inspection, local isolated API/VM tests, independent text/link/media checks; only this review receipt was written by the reviewer.

resolved_findings.title: Raw-byte declaration check and parsed-tree filtering allowed forbidden SVG constructs
resolved_findings.before: The original validator accepted an external xml-stylesheet processing instruction because ElementTree omits it from the parsed element tree; UTF-16 DTD bytes bypassed the ASCII <! check; xml:base could change the resolution of an apparently local fragment.
resolved_findings.impact_boundary: Confirmed passive-document validation bypass. Browser script execution was not tested or claimed; inline image handling and direct SVG navigation have different browser restrictions.
resolved_findings.fix: Author enforced UTF-8, rejected declarations, processing instructions and NUL; required exact SVG namespaces and a small attribute allowlist, rejecting xml:base/style/external attributes and CSS escapes.
resolved_findings.independent_recheck: All three previously accepted payloads now raise ValueError; all 12 real diagram originals and all 12 declared derived media files pass the updated validator, path and hash checks.

resolved_findings.title: Unfinished region selection on another workspace blocked method image viewing
resolved_findings.before: openStructureImage returned on any state.drawMode. switchWorkspace did not clear that state, so choosing region comment in the story workspace then switching to method reading prevented image click/keyboard activation.
resolved_findings.reproduction: Evaluate the actual openStructureImage function with state.drawMode="story-diagram-id" and mediaBase="/approach-media/". Before the fix openReviewDialog was called zero times.
resolved_findings.fix: Author restricted the drawing guard to /assets/ image viewing while preserving the existing duplicate-dialog guard.
resolved_findings.independent_recheck: The actual function now opens the method dialog once, still blocks the story /assets/ dialog during drawing, and leaves state.drawMode unchanged. Added author regression also passes.
